- feat(plugins): show catalog icons on plugin cards by @RyanGroch in #4760
- test(e2e): wait for each env var row before the next edit by @RyanGroch in #4788

- Try API-key authentication for issue automation by @wwwillchen in #4807

- Bump to v1.20.0-beta.1 by @wwwillchen in #4818
